{"metadata":{"kernelspec":{"display_name":"Python 3","language":"python","name":"python3"},"language_info":{"name":"python"}},"nbformat_minor":5,"nbformat":4,"cells":[{"id":"e16a2d70-be78-4e6a-bb7f-fb85761e7974","cell_type":"markdown","source":"# Hamiltonian Integrity Score (HIS): validacion matematica en CPU\n## EQG §2.9 — consolidado con rigor tecnico\n\n**Objetivo.** Validar en CPU (sin fabricar datos de QPU) el marco que desplaza la narrativa de EQG desde *mejora de AR en MaxCut* hacia *preservacion de la estimacion de observables de Pauli*, y emitir un **go / no-go** para una prueba HIS en hardware real.\n\n**Alineacion.** Technical Report EQG (validacion AR en ibm_fez / marrakesh / kingston) + protocolo HIVP (H1–H4, C8, ABBA).\n\n---\n\n### Definicion\n\n$$\n\\langle H\\rangle = \\langle\\psi|H|\\psi\\rangle = \\sum_j p_j \\lambda_j,\\qquad p_j = |\\langle j|\\psi\\rangle|^2.\n$$\n\n$$\n\\mathrm{HIS}(\\langle H\\rangle_{\\mathrm{id}},\\langle H\\rangle_{\\mathrm{re}})\n= 1 - \\frac{|\\langle H\\rangle_{\\mathrm{id}}-\\langle H\\rangle_{\\mathrm{re}}|}{|\\langle H\\rangle_{\\mathrm{id}}|}\n\\quad\\text{si }|\\langle H\\rangle_{\\mathrm{id}}|\\ge\\varepsilon;\\quad\n\\text{indefinido (NaN) si }|\\langle H\\rangle_{\\mathrm{id}}|<\\varepsilon.\n$$\n\n**Convencion academica:** si $|\\langle H\\rangle_{\\mathrm{id}}|<\\varepsilon$, se reporta ademas el error absoluto $|\\langle H\\rangle_{\\mathrm{id}}-\\langle H\\rangle_{\\mathrm{re}}|$ y se elige un estado de referencia con $|\\langle H\\rangle_{\\mathrm{id}}|\\ge\\varepsilon$ para el barrido principal. EQG no modifica $\\{\\lambda_j\\}$; solo puede actuar sobre $\\{p_j\\}$.\n\n| HIS | Interpretacion |\n|-----|----------------|\n| 1.00 | Coincidencia perfecta |\n| 0.95 | Desviacion relativa 5% |\n| < 0.80 | Degradacion significativa |\n| < 0.50 | Observable pobremente preservado |\n| NaN | Referencia ideal degenerada ($\\langle H\\rangle\\approx 0$) |\n\n**HRF** $= \\mathrm{HIS}_E/\\mathrm{HIS}_A$ (solo con HIS definido en ambos brazos).\n","metadata":{}},{"id":"2fb5c895-d9b9-439b-a15f-f2aff8c56f15","cell_type":"code","source":"import json, math\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Dict, List, Tuple, Optional\nimport numpy as np\nimport matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n\nnp.random.seed(42)\nOUT = Path(\"/kaggle/working/his_consolidated\") if Path(\"/kaggle/working\").exists() else Path(\"his_consolidated\")\nOUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n\nEPS = 1e-8\nN = 4\n\ndef HIS(h_id: float, h_re: float, eps: float = EPS) -> float:\n    d = abs(h_id)\n    if d < eps:\n        return float(\"nan\")\n    return 1.0 - abs(h_id - h_re) / d\n\ndef abs_err(h_id: float, h_re: float) -> float:\n    return abs(h_id - h_re)\n\ndef HRF(his_e: float, his_a: float, eps: float = EPS) -> float:\n    if abs(his_a) < eps or math.isnan(his_a) or math.isnan(his_e):\n        return float(\"nan\")\n    return his_e / his_a\n\nprint(\"HIS consolidado  n=%d  eps=%.1e\" % (N, EPS))\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-12T14:36:19.582294Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-12T14:36:19.582644Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-12T14:36:19.599835Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-12T14:36:19.582613Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-12T14:36:19.598755Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"HIS consolidado  n=4  eps=1.0e-08\n","output_type":"stream"}],"execution_count":28},{"id":"3acad63b-fc0e-4241-a55c-d10911cfc3d3","cell_type":"markdown","source":"## 1. q) * p + q / d\n\ndef bitflip_noise(p: np.ndarray, n_qubits: int, eps: float) -> np.ndarray:\n    d = 1 << n_qubits\n    out = np.zeros(d)\n    for x, px in enumerate(p):\n        for y in range(d):\n            diff = x ^ y\n            pr = 1.0\n            for b in range(n_qubits):\n                pr *= (eps if (diff >> b) & 1 else (1 - eps))\n            out[y] += px * pr\n    s = out.sum()\n    return out / s if s > 0 else out\n\nn3 = 3\nd3 = 1 << n3\np_ideal = np.zeros(d3)\np_ideal[0] = 0.45\np_ideal[7] = 0.35\np_ideal[1] = 0.10\np_ideal[6] = 0.10\nlam = np.array([3.0, -1.0, -1.0, 0.5, 0.5, -1.0, -1.0, 2.0])\nh_ideal = expectation(p_ideal, lam)\nassert abs(h_ideal) >= EPS\n\nqs = np.linspace(0, 1, 11)\nhis_dep, his_bf = [], []\nfor q in qs:\n    his_dep.append(HIS(h_ideal, expectation(depolarize_probs(p_ideal, q), lam)))\n    his_bf.append(HIS(h_ideal, expectation(bitflip_noise(p_ideal, n3, eps=q * 0.5), lam)))\n\nprint(\"<H>_ideal = %.6f\" % h_ideal)\nprint(\"Depolarizing  q=0  HIS=%.4f | q=0.5 HIS=%.4f | q=1 HIS=%.4f\" % (\n    his_dep[0], his_dep[5], his_dep[-1]))\nassert his_dep[0] > 0.999 and his_dep[-1] < his_dep[0]\nprint(\"PASSED: HIS responde a degradacion de {p_j} con lambdas fijos\")\n\n# Escala de H no cambia HIS bajo el mismo mapa de p\nlam2 = lam * 2\np_n = depolarize_probs(p_ideal, 0.3)\nhis_H = HIS(expectation(p_ideal, lam), expectation(p_n, lam))\nhis_2H = HIS(expectation(p_ideal, lam2), expectation(p_n, lam2))\nassert abs(his_H -  \"I\": np.array([[1, 0], [0, 1]], dtype=complex),\n    \"X\": np.array([[0, 1], [1, 0]], dtype=complex),\n    \"Y\": np.array([[0, -1j], [1j, 0]], dtype=complex),\n    \"Z\": np.array([[1, 0], [0, -1]], dtype=complex),\n}\n\ndef kron_n(mats):\n    out = np.array([[1.0 + 0j]])\n    for m in mats:\n        out = np.kron(out, m)\n    return out\n\ndef matrix_from_pauli_sum(terms: List[Tuple[str, float]], n: int) -> np.ndarray:\n    H = np.zeros((1 << n, 1 << n), dtype=complex)\n    for label, w in terms:\n        assert len(label) == n\n        H = H + w * kron_n([PAULI[c] for c in label])\n    return H\n\ndef H_ising_path(n):\n    terms = []\n    for i in range(n - 1):\n        z = [\"I\"] * n; z[i] = \"Z\"; z[i + 1] = \"Z\"\n        terms.append((\"\".join(z), -0.5))\n        terms.append((\"I\" * n, 0.5))\n    return terms\n\ndef H_qubo(n, seed=7):\n    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)\n    terms = []\n    for i in range(n):\n        z = [\"I\"] * n; z[i] = \"Z\"\n        terms.append((\"\".join(z), float(rng.uniform(-1, 1))))\n    for i in range(n):\n        for j in range(i + 1, n):\n            z = [\"I\"] * n; z[i] = \"Z\"; z[j] = \"Z\"\n            terms.append((\"\".join(z), float(rng.uniform(-0.4, 0.4))))\n    return terms\n\ndef H_coloring(n):\n    terms = []\n    for i in range(n - 1):\n        z = [\"I\"] * n; z[i] = \"Z\"; z[i + 1] = \"Z\"\n        terms.append((\"\".join(z), 1.0))\n    return terms\n\ndef H_random(n, n_terms=8, seed=21):\n    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)\n    terms = []\n    for _ in range(n_terms):\n        s = \"\".join(rng.choice(list(\"IXYZ\")) for _ in range(n))\n        terms.append((s, float(rng.normal())))\n    return terms\n\nHAM_TERMS = {\n    \"Ising_MaxCut\": H_ising_path(N),\n    \"QUBO_Portfolio\": H_qubo(N),\n    \"Graph_Coloring\": H_coloring(N),\n    \"Random_Pauli\": H_random(N),\n}\nHAM_MAT = {k: matrix_from_pauli_sum(v, N) for k, v in HAM_TERMS.items()}\n\n# Estado de referencia: |0...0> y, si <H>~0, el eigenestado de mayor |eigenvalor|\ndef reference_state(Hmat: np.ndarray) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, float]:\n    d = Hmat.shape[0]\n    # try |0>\n    psi = np.zeros(d, dtype=complex); psi[0] = 1.0\n    hid = float(np.real(np.vdot(psi, Hmat @ psi)))\n    if abs(hid) >= EPS:\n        return psi, hid\n    # try equal superposition\n    psi = np.ones(d, dtype=complex) / np.sqrt(d)\n    hid = float(np.real(np.vdot(psi, Hmat @ psi)))\n    if abs(hid) >= EPS:\n        return psi, hid\n    # dominant eigenvector (max |lambda|)\n    evals, evecs = np.linalg.eigh(Hmat)\n    idx = int(np.argmax(np.abs(evals)))\n    psi = evecs[:, idx]\n    hid = float(np.real(evals[idx]))\n    return psi, hid\n\nprint(\"%-16s  %12s  %s\" % (\"Hamiltoniano\", \"<H>_ref\", \"ref\"))\nrefs = {}\nfor name, Hm in HAM_MAT.items():\n    psi, hid = reference_state(Hm)\n    refs[name] = (psi, hid)\n    assert abs(hid) >= EPS, name\n    print(\"%-16s  %12.6f  OK\" % (name, HIS mide preservacion de $\\langle H\\rangle$ bajo deformacion de $\\{p_j\\}$, con eigenvalores fijos, y aplica al menos a Ising, QUBO, coloring y Pauli aleatorio.\n\n**Error corregido respecto a corridas previas:** el NaN en QUBO/Coloring/Random venia de $|\\langle H\\rangle_{\\mathrm{id}}|\\approx 0$ con superposicion uniforme; se resuelve con estado de referencia y convencion $\\varepsilon$.\n\n**Hardware:** con la madurez actual del proyecto (metrica + HIVP + evidencia AR/Centinela), la decision consolidada es **GO** a una prueba HIS **acotada** (un backend, T1+T5, ABBA, C8), no a una campana amplia.
